_readme: A Tutorial Hub drill. Reference: Documentation/TrainingHub/README.md. Fields starting with '_' are notes.
guided / mastery: 'steps' play in order (each waits for the one before); 'hints' react whenever their 'when' happens.
A step with 'use' copies that lesson from the level's guide.json (Resources/Tutorials/Level_01/guide.json), so the in-game wording stays in one place.
Other steps are written here in the guide.json lesson format. Mastery steps have no 'point': no hand, no spotlight, just the goal.
The run ends when its LAST step ends. hide = scene parts switched off for this drill (lighter, quieter).
title: Your Screen

pages.text: Back for a refresher? Smart move. Let's walk through your screen again, piece by piece.
That's your whole screen! Next time, try the mastery run: I'll only name things, and you find them.
Mastery run! No hand, no spotlight. I name it, you find it. Ready?
Open the paper that lists ALL of today's steps.
Your tracker says what's next. Go there! The pin on your minimap shows the way.
Sharp eyes! You read your screen like a pro.
